dataset: Locate U — India administrative & populated places
coverage_note: District boundaries follow Census 2011 (641 polygons, reconciled to today's 28 states and 8 UTs). Districts created after 2011 are NOT represented separately; their places appear under the 2011 parent district. Populated places are GeoNames settlements with population >= 500 plus CSC cities — this is NOT every village in India.
